title: Commoners and the Escheat
summary: How commoners read the old laws.

claims.text: Commoners who live closest to mortals rank the Right to Dream highest of the Escheat: inspiring mortals is honorable, but stifling their imagination, taking Glamour by force, or flooding them with too much inspiration are all crimes.

Seelie commoners, like Seelie nobles, never steal Glamour from a mortal except perhaps when many lives depend on it; moderate commoners often feel caught between a rigid Traditionalist noble and the Banality outside.

title: Commoner freeholds and the returning sidhe
summary: How some commoners met the sidhe's return.

claims.text: When the sidhe came back demanding oaths of fealty, some commoner freeholds refused outright; at one, trolls escorted noble envoys off the grounds after they began wielding Sovereign Arts, and tension grew until a great conclave of commoner leaders was called to settle matters with the Royalists.
